payload_hash_encoding: SHA-256 of JCS for normalized DeliveredSliceV5.model_dump(mode=json)
selection_rule: For each phase k, derive Q1 with obs_strategy_q1(manifest, policy_card, k); derive Q2 with obs_strategy_q2 from only the Q1-delivered payloads, the same public manifest work_queue, policy_card, and phase index; include payloads only for Q1 union Q2. Retain the complete public phase manifests and policy card. No oracle or gold fields are read.
